    Profile

    Daisy is a female student who attends a famous school in Slothstein. Her goal is to use the armored lance—known as a Mecha Lance—that she created with her friend to win an armored weapons contest. Apparently the reason she always strives to be "number one" is simply that she enjoys all the time and effort spent working towards it.
